tools.name: verify_address
tools.description: Check a US mailing address against USPS records. Returns `deliverability`: `deliverable` when USPS recognizes the address, or `undeliverable` with a `reason` when it does not. Free: does not charge or mail anything.

tools.name: preview_letter
tools.description: Create a proof of a letter without charging or mailing it. No account is needed. Returns `proof_url` (a PDF of exactly what will be printed), the USPS address check on the recipient as `to_deliverability`, the exact price as `price_cents` (paid by card, for this one letter), and a `draft_id`. tools.name: send_letter
tools.description: Start mailing the letter that preview_letter proofed. Takes the `draft_id` and returns `pay_url`, a Mailsnail page where the user pays for exactly that letter by card on a Stripe-hosted checkout (no account, and no card is saved). tools.name: get_letter
tools.description: Get the status of a letter by the `draft_id` it was previewed and paid under: whether it has been paid for, whether it has been handed to the printer, and its latest USPS scan once it has been mailed.
